QuestInfo.name: The Maple-Factor
QuestInfo.0: Triple Volt isn't giving up. Ask Vicky about their new plan.
QuestInfo.1: Vicky says Triple Volt isn't ready to give up! She needs you to bring her 50 more audition Scratch Cards, which you can acquire by hunting Mango Bubble Teas. The more Cards you collect, the better their chances of getting that audition!
QuestInfo.2: You didn't find any winning tickets in this batch either. Sad face.

0.0: We can't give up now. Help us some more and I know we'll get in!
0.1: I hear that people have had good luck with #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k. You can find them on Mango Bubble Teas.
0.2: #b50#k #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k from #rMango Bubble Teas#k should do it.\r\n

yes.0: Great! I'm counting on you! Hunt some #rMango Bubble Teas#k and I'm sure you'll be able to snag #b50#k #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k.

no.0: Hey, kid. Help me out, will ya?

1.0: Did you get all of the Scratchcards?

0.msg: Well... here goes. Hey, Victor, Vincent! Help me scratch these bad boys!

3.msg: Arrrrggghhh!! My dreams have been shattered!! All I want is to be a famous singer and swim in a pool of cash. Is that so much to ask?

item.0: Hey, stop wasting time! Remember, the mission is to hunt #rMango Bubble Teas#k and collect #b50#k #rBetter Audition Scratchcards#k.
